title: Informed Consent
description: The child may not fully understand or be informed about the implications of sharing their live GPS coordinates, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Identity Disclosure
description: The transmission of live GPS coordinates could potentially allow for the identification of the child, especially if the data is intercepted during transmission.

title: Data Retention
description: The backend may retain the GPS data longer than necessary, leading to potential misuse or unauthorized access to the child's location history.

title: Unintended Use of Data
description: The backend may use the GPS data for purposes other than originally intended, such as marketing or profiling, without the child's consent.

title: Data Disclosure from Mobile App Backend
description: The mobile app backend collects and writes location pings to the Location History Store, which may lead to the unintended disclosure of personal location data if not properly managed or secured.

title: Data Disclosure in Location History Store
description: The Location History Store may expose personal location data to unauthorized access or sharing, leading to potential data disclosure risks.

title: Data Disclosure from Mobile App Backend
description: The mobile app backend forwards location pings, which may include personal data, to the Geofencing Engine. If this data is not strictly necessary for the geofencing functionality, it represents a potential data disclosure threat.

title: Data Disclosure by Geofencing & Alert Engine
description: The Geofencing & Alert Engine processes the location pings received from the backend. If it retains or shares this data beyond the intended purpose, it poses a risk of data disclosure.

title: Unauthorized Access to Family Account
description: There is a risk that unauthorized users may gain access to the Family Account Store, leading to potential data leaks or misuse of sensitive information regarding family locations and permissions.

title: Inadequate Data Handling Practices
description: The Geofencing & Alert Engine may not handle the retrieved zone definitions securely, leading to potential exposure of sensitive location data to unauthorized parties.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The Geofencing & Alert Engine may retain location data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Inadequate Consent Management
description: The Geofencing Engine may not have obtained proper consent from the child or parent for tracking their location, leading to potential legal and ethical issues.

title: Insecure Data Handling by Parent
description: The parent may mishandle the arrival/departure notifications, leading to unauthorized access or sharing of sensitive location data.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The parent may retain the location data longer than necessary, violating data minimization principles and increasing the risk of data breaches.

title: Inadequate Consent Mechanism
description: The parent may not fully understand what data is being collected or how it will be used, leading to a lack of informed consent when registering the child's profile.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The mobile app backend may store sensitive information (child's name, DOB, school) insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access.

title: Data Misuse
description: The mobile app backend may use the collected data for purposes other than those explicitly stated, such as marketing or profiling.

title: Unintended Data Sharing
description: The mobile app backend may unintentionally share the child's profile data with third parties without the parent's knowledge or consent.

title: Data Disclosure from Backend to Data Store
description: The mobile app backend may unintentionally disclose personal data (account, child profile, geofence zone data) to the Family Account & Permissions Store, which could lead to unauthorized access or exposure of sensitive information.

title: Data Disclosure at Data Store
description: The Family Account & Permissions Store may improperly handle or expose personal data stored within it, leading to potential data breaches or unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Inadequate Consent
description: The parent may not have provided explicit consent for the mobile app to access the child's location data, leading to a potential violation of privacy rights.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The mobile app backend may store the child's location data insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Data Misuse
description: The mobile app backend may misuse the child's location data for purposes other than what was originally intended or disclosed to the parent.

title: Location Data Leakage
description: The location history stored in the DataStore may be accessed by unauthorized processes or users, leading to potential leakage of sensitive location data.

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The Mobile App Backend may not have adequate access controls in place, allowing unauthorized access to the retrieved location history data.

title: Data Misuse
description: The Mobile App Backend may misuse the retrieved location history data for purposes other than intended, such as selling or sharing with third parties without consent.

title: Linkability Threat
description: The act of inviting a secondary guardian may expose the parent's identity and link it to the child's location data, potentially allowing others to infer relationships and connections.

title: Invisibility Threat
description: The mobile app backend may not adequately inform the parent about how the secondary guardian's access to the child's location data is managed, leading to a lack of transparency regarding data sharing.

title: Data Disclosure Threat
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently disclose the child's location data to unauthorized parties if proper access controls are not implemented.

title: Location Data Leakage
description: The mobile app backend shares the child's live location with the secondary guardian, which could lead to unauthorized access or exposure of sensitive location data if proper access controls are not in place.

title: Insecure Interaction with Secondary Guardian
description: The secondary guardian may interact with the received location data in an insecure manner, potentially leading to unauthorized sharing or misuse of the child's location information.

title: Data Misuse by Secondary Guardian
description: The secondary guardian may misuse the child's location data for purposes other than intended, such as tracking the child without consent or sharing the data with others.

title: Loss of Control over Personal Data
description: The mobile app backend shares aggregated usage and engagement analytics with an external advertising/analytics partner, which may lead to loss of control over how this data is used or further shared by the partner.

title: Inadequate Information Handling by External Entity
description: The advertising/analytics partner may inadequately handle the aggregated data received, leading to potential misuse or unauthorized access to the data.

title: Data Misuse by External Entity
description: The external entity may use the aggregated analytics data for purposes beyond what was originally intended, such as targeted advertising without user consent.

title: Attributable data evidence
description: The SOS message sent by the child can be attributed to the child, potentially exposing their identity and location to unauthorized parties.

title: Insecure data handling
description: The mobile app backend may not securely handle the received SOS message, leading to potential exposure of the child's location and identity.

title: Linkability of data
description: The data received by the mobile app backend could be linked to the child's identity, especially if combined with other data, leading to privacy concerns.
